description: Instead of waiting for cast bars to finish from the backline, this playstyle demands that you stay in the thick of the melee scrum. You are actively managing a fluid triage inventory—generating resources through precise offensive strikes and instantly allocating those resources to keep your frontline alive.

items.name: Syringe-Belt of the Apothecary
items.stats:
+130 Agility
+100 Stamina
Equip: Converts combo-point generators into abilities that passively store healing charges (Vials) based on damage dealt.
items.description: A micro-pneumatic distribution system, loaded with a permanent base layer of coagulant.

setBonuses.text: (3) Set: Defibrillating Strike applies a 15% damage reduction shield to the target for 6 seconds.

origin.details: Drops from a mad-scientist or undead boss in a mid-tier dungeon (e.g., Scholomance or a similar gothic instance).

catalyst.details: Rebuild the micro-pneumatic distribution system, while synthesizing and loading a permanent base layer of coagulant into the belt’s primary reservoir.

items.name: Triage Goggles
items.stats:
+140 Agility
+110 Haste
Equip: Unlocks the ability to target allies with finishing moves, scaling the heal based on the combo points and Vials allocated to the cast.
items.description: A heavy-duty, sterile cowl housing a highly sensitive tracking matrix.

setBonuses.text: (3) Set: Defibrillating Strike applies a 15% damage reduction shield to the target for 6 seconds.

origin.details: A rare drop from a high-value assassination target located deep within a hostile, max-level enemy stronghold.

catalyst.details: Cut pristine diagnostic prisms to replace the optics, and stitch a heavy-duty, sterile cowl to house the sensitive tracking matrix.

items.name: Bone-Saws of the Flesh-Shaper
items.stats:
+180 Agility
+120 Critical Strike
Equip: Enables the Defibrillating Strike emergency heal. Auto-attacks passively heal the lowest-health ally in your immediate melee vicinity.
items.description: Purified in an aura of light to extract life without passing on the corruption.

setBonuses.text: (3) Set: Defibrillating Strike applies a 15% damage reduction shield to the target for 6 seconds.

origin.details: A paired drop from a council-style boss encounter in a major endgame raid.

catalyst.details: Carefully re-hone the serrated edges using heat-treated raid metals, and bathe the blades in a purifying aura.
